How We Do It Proof Points Resources Customers Meet the Industry’s first Supply Chain Detection and Response Solution Despite having more tools than ever, organizations still struggle to manage supply chain risk effectively. The traditional many-to-many model creates chaos with duplicated efforts, misaligned timelines, and zero visibility across fragmented systems. SecurityScorecard’s Supply Chain Detection and Response (SCDR) reimagines this model, giving you a unified, scalable approach to take control and act, not just collect data. Outcomes Reduce cyber risk across your third- and fourth-party ecosystem Strengthen continuity, protect critical suppliers, and free up your team with automated workflows. Stay audit-ready and compliant Mitigate risk in real time, map regulations in-platform, and deliver board-ready reports so you’re always prepared. Demonstrate ROI and Reduce Operational Costs C ite reduced incidents and use board-ready dashboards and reports to communicate supply chain risk in context of business and financial impact How does it work? SecurityScorecard’s SCDR connects security and risk teams through a unified platform that accelerates response and reduces third-party risk at scale. By layering real-time threat intelligence over continuous vendor monitoring, it detects critical threats, from APTs to systemic risk concentrations, and initiates automated remediation. Integrated vendor collaboration closes the loop fast, minimizing dwell time and helping prevent supply chain breaches before they start. How We Do It Continuous monitoring Prevent third-party breaches with continuous risk monitoring that delivers real-time visibility into high-severity vulnerabilities, active infections, and indicators of compromise so you can protect your brand and bottom line. Supplier lifecycle management Reduce breach risk and ensure compliance by securely managing third-party vendors across onboarding, monitoring, remediation, and offboarding. Supplier collaboration and remediation Gain repeatable processes for both you and your vendors that scale with your vendor ecosystem. Accelerate incident response and cut issue resolution time by up to 90%.
